evidence.quoted_text:
source_commit = (getattr(args, "source_commit", None)
                     or os.environ.get("CRQ_VM_SOURCE_COMMIT"))
    if not isinstance(source_commit, str) or not COMMIT_RE.fullmatch(source_commit):
        raise ValueError("run requires --source-commit with the full git commit "
                         "whose tree produced the executed scripts")
evidence.reason: The command's own precondition says --source-commit must be the full commit whose tree produced the executed scripts, but cmd_run only regex-validates the string. It later copies and hashes the actual host/guest scripts without comparing those hashes to the blobs at source_commit, so a stale env value or dirty worktree can be recorded as provenance under an unrelated commit. That is an implementation gap in the existing provenance behavior, not merely a new hardening request.
